content.description: Havrilla Heavy Denim "STINGER CNFT-Collection". This collectible „10 Years Anniversary HAVRILLA HEAVY DENIM CNFT-Series 001“ consists of 1.700 CNFT’s and is available on Cardano now! The series shows the basic architecture of the HAVRILLA HEAVY DENIM Bag Model "STINGER" and is compiled from 20 outstanding designs, 8 color-variations, different accessories and various backgrounds. All Denim-Bag-Models displayed in this series were designed, manufactured and sold between 2012 and 2022. Therefore are physical counterparts to almost every CNFT out there somewhere.
